title: 1.1 Traversals Protocol
concept: Preorder, Inorder, Postorder, and Level-Order tree traversals
objective: Visit all 7 rooms in the exact order required by the active traversal protocol!
controls: Click nodes in the active traversal sequence  |  [C] Cycle Traversal  |  Hover for stats
start_status: Follow the active traversal sequence shown above and click each room in order.
hints: Preorder (Root -> Left -> Right): visit a room the moment you reach it, then finish its left wing before its right wing.
Inorder (Left -> Root -> Right): finish a room's entire left subtree first, then visit the room itself, then its right subtree.
Postorder (Left -> Right -> Root): visit both children's subtrees completely before clicking their parent room.
Level-Order (Breadth-First): sweep level by level from top to bottom, and left to right within each depth.
